title: QUBO-based feature selection for MRI undersampling pattern design
abstract: arXiv:2611.25625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We formulate undersampling mask design for Cartesian magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as a feature subset selection problem. Each sampling line is represented by a binary feature indicating whether it is included in each candidate mask. Using candidate masks and their training-set evaluations, we estimate mutual information (MI) and conditional mutual information (CMI). These estimates and a sampling-count penalty define a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. The model is solved using simulated annealing and quantum annealing to determine a feature subset and its corresponding sampling mask. We assess the selected subsets on the test set through zero-filled reconstruction in Fourier undersampling simulations using fastMRI knee magnitude reference images, with patient-disjoint training and test sets. At all six tested target sampling rates from 15% to 40%, the resulting reconstructions have lower mean root mean square

translated_title: 基于QUBO的特征选择用于MRI欠采样模式设计
translated_abstract: 我们将笛卡尔磁共振成像（MRI）的欠采样掩模设计形式化为一个特征子集选择问题。每条采样线由一个二元特征表示，用于指示其是否包含在每个候选掩模中。利用候选掩模及其在训练集上的评估结果，我们估计了互信息和条件互信息。这些估计值与采样数量惩罚项共同定义了一个二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型。该模型通过模拟退火和量子退火求解，以确定特征子集及其对应的采样掩模。我们使用fastMRI膝关节幅值参考图像，在患者不相交的训练集与测试集设置下，通过傅里叶欠采样仿真中的零填充重建，在测试集上评估了所选择的子集。在从15%到40%的所有六个测试目标采样率下，所得重建具有更低的均方根
tldr: 该论文创新性地将MRI笛卡尔欠采样掩模设计转化为基于互信息与条件互信息的QUBO特征子集选择问题，利用模拟退火和量子退火求解，在15%至40%的所有测试采样率下均取得了更优的重建质量。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates Cartesian MRI undersampling mask design as a QUBO-based feature subset selection problem using mutual information and conditional mutual information estimates, solved via simulated annealing and quantum annealing, achieving lower reconstruction error across all tested sampling rates from 15% to 40%.
